context: Adds an 'advanced' search mode that lets power users type raw regex patterns into the product search box.
explanation: When advanced=true the raw, unescaped, unbounded user string is passed straight to MongoDB's $regex. A client can submit a pathological pattern (e.g. nested quantifiers like (a+)+$) that takes catastrophic time to evaluate, tying up the event loop or the database's regex engine (ReDoS). It also drops the previous length cap on the input. Fix: keep escaping/length-limiting user input, or if raw patterns are truly needed, validate them against a safe regex library (e.g. re2) with a time budget.
